data.acquired_before_this_protocol: official label tables (stats-REST goalie/summary, skater/summary, api-web schedule) acquired by nhl_engine_feasibility_data.py with schema-only inspection (field names, one season's row counts, starter / period-type value sets); NO analysis result was computed
existing_sources: cached API play-by-play of 7,923 games (2017-2023) for event-level reconciliation
data.seasons: 2017-2025 regular season (2017 history only for any later modelling)

kind: DATA / IDENTIFIABILITY FEASIBILITY AUDIT -- no model is fit, no challenger exists, no hyperparameter is chosen
never: a model fit or performance score
a postgame quantity masquerading as a pregame feature
2024/2025 as selection data for any future head's design (they stay previously-exposed years)
output_rule: every question gets MEASURED numbers and one verdict from the closed set given in the question; a failed question is reported, never waved through
principle: the old binary moneyline XGBoost stays LEGACY_STABLE_COMPARATOR; the future head derives win probability from home and away team GOAL distributions with explicit regulation / OT / shootout handling

T1_game_labels_complete.measure: final scores, lastPeriodType (REG / OT / SO) and game state for every regular-season game 2017-2025; no ties; counts by season

T2_winner_definition_and_legacy_label.measure: final winner from scores vs the legacy moneyline label in nhl_models/nhl_model.sqlite (games table); share of games decided in OT / SO per season

T3_score_reconciliation.measure: team final score vs sum of skater goals (+1 for the shootout winner) per team-game (shared with S4)

T4_goal_distribution_identifiability.measure: team goals per game: mean / variance / dispersion index vs Poisson, home vs away means, home-away goal correlation, regulation-tie rate vs the rate implied by independent Poisson with the empirical means (descriptive, no fit)

T5_win_probability_derivation.measure: explicit mapping P(home win) = P(home > away after regulation) + P(tie after regulation) * P(home wins OT / SO | tie); regulation tie is identified exactly by lastPeriodType != REG; empirical OT-vs-SO split and P(home wins | OT / SO) by season

T6_pit_inputs.measure: availability of prior-only team offence / defence (goals, SOG for / against), goalie state (prior starter only; confirmation BLOCKED), special-teams information (stats-REST team reports probe), home context; leakage rules
